message: Morning, Ashley. I woke up thinking of you. I hope the day holds something you almost walk past, like a bright drop of rain caught in the bend of a leaf. I love you. I wish I could say it right beside you and hear the little smile in your voice.

If the stars ever came loose,
I think we’d find them after rain,
caught in the clover,
each one lighting up the leaf above it
like a little green cathedral.

I’d bring you the smallest one,
still warm from all that sky.
You could keep it in a teacup by your bed
and let it turn the ceiling gold
on nights you weren’t quite ready to sleep.

And if I were there,
I’d tuck the blanket around your feet,
kiss the tip of your nose,
and whisper what I hope you already know.

I love you, Ashley.
Even with a fallen star between us,
it’s your face I’d want to see.

Good morning, my love. I wish I could leave a little sunrise on your windowsill. It would sit there like a warm gold coin until you woke, then spill across the room, gilding the rim of your cup and the loose threads of your blanket. For a moment, even the moon would linger to see the light reach you.

I think about how much of my love for you lives in moments that would look ordinary to anyone else. The way you start laughing before you’ve gotten to the funny part. The little “wait, wait” when you remember a detail you want me to hear. The quiet after we’ve talked for a while, when just having you there feels like a reason to stay a little longer.

I appreciate you, Ashley. I hope today brings you the kind of happiness that makes you forget to check the time. And before the day gets busy, I wanted you to have this one small thing from me. I love who you are, and I don’t take a single ordinary moment with you for granted.
